name: Gujarat Ayurved University
evidence: The official homepage describes Gujarat Ayurved University as a statutory university established in 1965 by an Act of the Gujarat State Government.
notes: The supplied hostname returned DNS NXDOMAIN; the official site resolving for the named institution is https://ayurveduniversity.edu.in, with a spelling difference in the domain.
Normal TLS verification failed with a self-signed certificate in the chain, so --insecure was used for the public GET as permitted.
